projects.title: Be a Brit Grad
projects.description:
The UK's Staffordshire University had entered the education scene in Kosova as an affiliate program with British Faculty of Business (BFoB). Being the first of its kind in the country, BfoB asked us to capture a potential market of parents and students who wish to obtain a genuine, British Bachelors or Masters degree from this prestigious university.
